description: Header file defining the TrustStoreWin class, which implements trust store management using Windows certificate stores, including methods for creation, initialization, and trust retrieval, along with internal CertStores structure.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin
classes.description: Implementation of TrustStore using Windows certificate system, providing thread-safe trust management and testing support.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin::CertStores
classes.description: Structure managing multiple Windows certificate stores, with factory methods for different testing and initialization scenarios.

methods.name: CreateForTesting
methods.description: Creates a TrustStoreWin instance with specified CertStores for testing.

methods.name: InitializeStores
methods.description: Loads user settings from Windows CertStores, may not read all stores if errors occur.

methods.name: SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: GetTrust
methods.description: Determines trust level for a given certificate.

methods.name: MaybeInitializeAndGetImpl
methods.description: Ensures stores are initialized and returns internal implementation pointer.
